text:
Anya Patel: quick daily check-in for the release train — what landed overnight, what still needs cherry-picks, any blockers for the 16:00 UTC window?

Mike Chen: merged #4921 (retry logic for client-side batching) to main last night. Need a manual backport to release/1.7 because of API surface changes. I can do the cherry-pick after lunch.

Sophia Ramos: staging smoke found intermittent 502s from emb-service during warmup. Root cause looks like connection exhaustion in the pool. Reproducer in staging logs:
```
ERR: failed to dial emb-service: connection refused
stack: grpc: failed to connect
```
I raised a hotfix PR to reduce pool size and add backoff: #4926 — needs review.

Anya Patel: thanks — @Mike if you can hold off on the backport until #4926 is in release/1.7, otherwise we risk exposing the 502s to canary.

Mike Chen: noted. I'll wait for #4926. Planning to run: `git checkout release/1.7 && git cherry-pick -x 3f2a1b7` once Sophia confirms merge.

Lia (deploy-bot): canary deploy for release/1.7 started at 2025-01-12T13:05:00Z. Health checks: 20/20 passing — rolling to 30%. :rocket:

Tom H: small heads-up — infra will perform a node reboot in GCP eu-west1 at 15:00 UTC for kernel patching. It should not affect dedicated pools but could slow down orchestrator ops for ~5m.

Jesse K: QA will run the regression suite at 14:00 UTC. If staging is flaky after the hotfix, ping me and I'll block the train.

Sophia Ramos: PR #4926 merged to main, backported to release/1.7 in #4927. I kicked a staging redeploy — monitoring now.

Anya Patel: great. Current action items: 1) Mike: hold cherry-pick until you see staging green (expected ~13:30 UTC). 2) Jesse: run regressions at 14:00. 3) Tom: watch for the 15:00 reboot side effects. We'll reconvene here if anything breaks.

Mike Chen: ack — will ping when cherry-pick done.

Lia (deploy-bot): canary deploy reached 100% at 2025-01-12T13:28:30Z. Post-deploy checks: latency p50/p95 within baseline, error budget unchanged.

Anya Patel: nice. No further blockers from my side. I'll mark this thread as the daily checkpoint. :white_check_mark:
